title: Gift Card Transaction Parameters
description: The parameters for creating a new gift card transaction.

amount.description: The transaction amount. Must be negative for REDEEMING transactions and positive for RELOADING transactions.

client_id.description: A unique transaction identifier for idempotency. The client must provide this and is normally the transaction id from the client system.

expires_at.description: Optional new expiry date for the gift card in YYYY-MM-DD format. Can be used to extend the gift card's expiry when reloading.

time_zone.description: The timezone to use when interpreting the `expires_at` date (e.g. "Pacific/Auckland"). See the list of tz database time zones for valid values.

user_id.description: The ID of the user creating the transaction. If omitted, the authenticated user will be used.
